env_allowlist.HOME: runner-provided toolchain home; identity is verified through the resolved Lean, Lake, and Bubblewrap executable digests
env_allowlist.PATH: runner-provided bootstrap path; the Elan Lake shim resolves the pinned Lean, after which the digest-checked sibling Lake drives LEAN_PATH discovery

network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs under Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host root, fixed environment variables, and one fresh temporary directory as its only writable bind. The outer Python reconciler performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line reconciliation, narrow replay, blocked-gate, and verdict summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed worker reconciliation plus a current network-isolated trust-zero warm-cache replay of the exact statement, conditional composition, five partial proof bodies, and three same-worker probes. It cannot provide either open directional BDF package, dependency or master acceptance, a cold release build, or independent verification.
